program:
PARAMS = {
    "gmid_in":   (18.0, 12.0, 24.0),     # CG pair / cascodes (weak inversion: low Vgs, low vdsat)
    "L_in":      (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),
    "I_ota":     (8e-6, 4e-6, 12e-6),    # current in each CG branch
    "I_div":     (30e-6, 15e-6, 34e-6),  # feedback divider current (also min-load bleeder for gm_pass)
    "gmid_pass": (14.0, 9.0, 18.0),      # pass device gm/Id at ILOAD_MAX (large W -> small gate swing)
    "Cc_n":      (14e-12, 4e-12, 40e-12),# vout -> NMOS cascode source (pull-down path, no PSRR penalty)
    "Cc_p":      (6e-12, 1e-12, 12e-12), # vout -> PMOS cascode source (pull-up path)
    "vfb0":      (0.12, 0.08, 0.2),      # unloaded divided reference / feedback level
    "Vlv":       (0.2, 0.14, 0.3),       # cascode level-shift (sets Vds of the CG pair)
}

def _vsg(lt, W, L, Id, vds):
    lo, hi = 0.2, 1.8
    for _ in range(40):
        mid = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
        if lt.op("p", W, L, mid, vds)["Id"] < Id:
            lo = mid
        else:
            hi = mid
    return 0.5 * (lo + hi)

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vref = spec.get("vref", 0.6); vo = spec.get("vout_target", 1.2)
    imax = spec.get("iload_max", 5e-3); imin = spec.get("iload_min", 50e-6)
    cl = spec.get("cl", 1e-9); iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    Io = p["I_ota"]; Ib = 4e-6

    # ---- dividers: feedback (vout) and reference (vref), matched Thevenin R so CG currents cancel
    Rtot = vo / p["I_div"]; R2 = Rtot * p["vfb0"] / vo; R1 = Rtot - R2
    Rth = R1 * R2 / Rtot
    Ra = vref * R1 / vo                      # Vout = vref*R1/Ra independent of I_ota
    Rb = 1.0 / (1.0 / Rth - 1.0 / Ra)
    vfb = p["vfb0"] + Io * Rth
    beta = R2 / Rtot

    # ---- device sizing
    mi = lut.size("n", p["gmid_in"], p["L_in"], Io, vds=0.2, vsb=vfb)            # M1, M2
    mc = lut.size("n", p["gmid_in"], 0.5, Io, vds=0.3, vsb=vfb + 0.2)            # Mc1, Mc
    mp = lut.size("p", 13, 1.0, Io, vds=0.25)                                    # MP1, MP2
    mpb = lut.size("p", 13, 1.0, Ib, vds=0.25)                                   # MPb
    mpc = lut.size("p", 13, 0.5, Io, vds=0.4)                                    # MP1c, MP2c
    mpbc = lut.size("p", 13, 0.5, Ib, vds=0.4)                                   # MPbc
    mnb = lut.size("n", 14, 2.0, iref, vds=0.5)                                  # IREF diode
    mns = lut.size("n", 14, 2.0, Ib, vds=0.5)                                    # bias sink
    mpass = lut.size("p", p["gmid_pass"], 0.15, imax * 1.02, vds=0.4)
    Rlv = p["Vlv"] / Io
    Rp = 0.18 / Ib

    n = Netlist("vin vout vref vss ibias")
    # bias: IREF -> NMOS diode -> sink Ib -> PMOS low-voltage cascode bias (pb, pcas)
    n.dev("MNb", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mnb)
    n.dev("MNs", "pcas", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mns)
    n.R("Rp", "pb", "pcas", Rp)
    n.dev("MPbc", "pb", "pcas", "yb", "vin", mpbc)
    n.dev("MPb", "yb", "pb", "vin", "vin", mpb)
    # reference branch (cascoded diode, level-shift resistor generates ncas)
    n.dev("MP1", "y1", "pb", "vin", "vin", mp)
    n.dev("MP1c", "ncas", "pcas", "y1", "vin", mpc)
    n.R("Rlv", "ncas", "ng", Rlv)
    n.dev("Mc1", "ng", "ncas", "x1", "vss", mc)
    n.dev("M1", "x1", "ng", "vr", "vss", mi)
    # gain branch -> pass gate pg
    n.dev("MP2", "y2", "pb", "vin", "vin", mp)
    n.dev("MP2c", "pg", "pcas", "y2", "vin", mpc)
    n.dev("Mc", "pg", "ncas", "x", "vss", mc)
    n.dev("M2", "x", "ng", "fb", "vss", mi)
    # pass device
    Wp = mpass.W
    if Wp > 4800:
        Wp = 4800.0
        mfp = 120
        n.M("Mpass", "vout", "pg", "vin", "vin", "pfet", Wp, 0.15, m=mfp)
        Cg = mpass.cgg * Wp / mpass.W; Cgd = mpass.cgd * Wp / mpass.W
    else:
        mfp = int(min(200, max(1, math.ceil(Wp / 40.0))))
        n.dev("Mpass", "vout", "pg", "vin", "vin", mpass, m=mfp)
        Cg = mpass.cgg; Cgd = mpass.cgd
    # dividers
    n.R("R1", "vout", "fb", R1); n.R("R2", "fb", "vss", R2)
    n.R("Ra", "vref", "vr", Ra); n.R("Rb", "vr", "vss", Rb)
    # cascode (Ahuja) compensation, both directions
    n.C("Ccn", "vout", "x", p["Cc_n"])
    n.C("Ccp", "vout", "y2", p["Cc_p"])

    # ---- first-order predictions
    Cc = p["Cc_n"] + p["Cc_p"]
    gdeg = 1 + (mi.gm + mi.gmbs) * Rth
    Gm = mi.gm / gdeg
    rout_n = (mc.gm + mc.gmbs) / mc.gds * (1.0 / mi.gds) * gdeg
    rout_p = mpc.gm / mpc.gds / mp.gds
    A1 = Gm * rout_n * rout_p / (rout_n + rout_p)
    Ip_min = imin + p["I_div"]
    gmp_l = 15.0 * Ip_min
    ugf = beta * Gm / (2 * PI * Cc)
    p2 = gmp_l * Cc / (Cg * cl) / (2 * PI)
    fx = mc.gm / (2 * PI * p["Cc_n"])
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(ugf / p2)) - math.degrees(math.atan(ugf / fx))
    w1k = 2 * PI * 1e3
    psrr = beta * Gm / abs(complex(1.0 / rout_n, w1k * (p["Cc_p"] + Cgd)))
    line = 1e3 * (1.0 / rout_n) / (beta * Gm)
    load = math.log(imax / Ip_min) / (beta * A1 * 12.0) / (imax - imin)
    try:
        dvg = _vsg(lut, Wp, 0.15, imax + p["I_div"], 0.6) - _vsg(lut, Wp, 0.15, Ip_min, 0.6)
        vsg_ss = _vsg(lut.at("ss", -40), Wp, 0.15, imax + p["I_div"], 0.42)
        pg_margin = (1.62 - vsg_ss) - (vfb + p["Vlv"] + 0.1)
    except Exception:
        dvg = 0.2; pg_margin = 0.0
    under = Cg * dvg / Cc + 0.05
    over = Cg * dvg / (p["Cc_p"] + Io * 150e-9 / max(dvg, 1e-3)) * 0.5
    iq = iref + Ib + 2 * Io + (vo - vfb) / R1
    return n, {"vout_err_pct": 0.3, "line_reg": line, "load_reg": load,
               "psrr_1k": db(psrr), "iq": iq, "undershoot": under, "overshoot": over,
               "ripple_settled": 0.002, "ugf_hz": ugf, "pm_deg": pm,
               "pg_headroom_ss_m40": pg_margin, "A1_db": db(A1)}
